brief:
An Israeli report claims that advanced unmanned aerial vehicles comparable to those possessed by Hezbollah are being transferred to Hamas, the Ma'an news agency reported. The assessment suggests a potential escalation in drone capabilities for the Palestinian militant group operating in Gaza.

The report did not specify the source of the drones, their expected arrival timeline, or detailed technical specifications of the aircraft in question. Israeli officials have previously raised concerns about weapons transfers to Hamas and other armed Palestinian factions, particularly regarding systems that could alter the balance of power in potential future conflicts.
title: Advanced drones similar to Hezbollah's arsenal heading to Hamas, Israeli report says
